database.description: The application's database: a connection's name, a named claim's (claims of the project), or a claim template, a database of its own ({}, the default), of a named provider ({provider: <namespace>/<release>}). A PostgreSQL one, with credentials: the application speaks PostgreSQL only. A database of its own has pgvector, which the package requests of every one (request); a named claim's is its project's, what it requests the declaration's.
